player_prompt.intro:
I ye Player {player_id} ye kɛlɛ lajɛnɛ Indian Poker.
- 52-kɛlɛ deck; i ye kɛlɛ kelen ye oponɛnɛ kɛlɛ.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kɔlɔn, {max_rounds} kɔlɔn(s) jumɛnɛ.
- Kɛlɛ wɛlɛ: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ye pɔsitiɲɛnɛ integer <= i chip count.)
- Kɛlɛ kɔnɔnɛ kɛlɛ ye pot lajɛnɛ showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Kɛlɛ kɛlɛ kɔlɔnɛ kɛlɛ, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', wa '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: I tɛ se k'a kɛ [check] - i be jɔrɔla.
invalid_move.amount_min: Wari/kafo ka kan ka se 1 ma.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Foyi tɛ ka wele; i bɛ se k'i [check] weele.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: I ka [bet X] kɛ k'a dayɛlɛ; i tɛ se ka wari bɔ.
invalid_move.insufficient: Nka, o tɛ se ka kɛ.

board.possible_actions: I be se ka koo minw kɛ: {legal}

message.showdown_tie: Ɲiningali laban: u fila {card}. Banakɔrɔnin tilan na  kelen-kelen bɛɛ be sɔrɔ {split} .

outcome.draw: Sumanw bɛɛ ka kan ni ɲɔgɔn ye laban na.
